name: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited
summary: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited provides stock brokerage services in India and internationally. The company offers equities, derivatives, alternative investment funds, IPOs, mutual funds, portfolio management services, investment basket, margin trading facility, NRI investing, commodities, currencies, fixed income, and insurance products. It also provides TradeMobi, an online app for trading and account related services; TradeXpress, a web-based platform to execute trades and access real-time market data; AR Invest; and Algozy for algorithmic trading strategies.
